contractSummary.LongContractSummaryPayrollNote: Luzardo's club option value reduces to $10 million if he spends 130 consecutive days on the injured list at any point in the contract.

$10M each from 2031 and 2033 is deferred, each paid in five installments of $2M each. The 2031 deferrals are paid from 2035-2039, and the 2032 deferrals from 2040-2044.

Sánchez's prior 4 yr, $22.5M extension, covering 2025-28 (with club options for 2029-30), is partially overwritten by the new extension beginning in 2027. Under his old extension, Sánchez's AAV was $5.625M, and remains such for 2025-26, even though Sánchez will only earn $6.5M ($3.25M AAV) over the two years of his extension. Because the Phillies are overcharged by $4.75M when comparing to what Sánchez actually earns, that difference is credited to the life of his new contract, further lowering its AAV.
